title: The Last Oath Revisited
author: Gideon Reyes
blurb: Mara Nystrom, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
